channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera Bread: BOGO $5: Whole Sandwiches, Bowls, Salads, and Soups
item.guid: Panera Bread-BOGO $5: Whole Sandwiches, Bowls, Salads-2026-08-21
item.description: Buy one whole sandwich, market bowl, salad, or soup and get a second for just $5 using promo code BOGO5 at online or in-app checkout; valid for delivery, pickup, or kiosk orders. (Limited time)

item.title: Top Pick: Chipotle: Free Chips and Queso with Any Entree
item.guid: Chipotle-Free Chips and Queso with Any Entree-2026-08-21
item.description: Order any full-priced entree on the Chipotle app or website and add a side of Chips and Queso Blanco for free; free Chipotle Rewards account required at checkout. (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: Harris Teeter: Sushi Friday: Sushi Entrees for $5
item.guid: Harris Teeter-Sushi Friday: Sushi Entrees for $5-2026-08-21
item.description: Every Friday, Harris Teeter offers select sushi entrees for just $5.00 at most stores while supplies last; free VIC card may be required at some locations. (Mid-Atlantic and Southeast only) (Ongoing (Fridays only))

item.title: Safeway: $5 Friday Sushi: Zenshi Rolls for $5
item.guid: Safeway-$5 Friday Sushi: Zenshi Rolls for $5-2026-08-21
item.description: Select Safeway stores with a fresh sushi counter offer Zenshi-brand rolls as part of the $5 Friday promotion; no purchase minimum required, while supplies last. (Select states only) (Ongoing (Fridays only))

item.title: Noodles and Company: Delicious Duo: Entree and Side from $9.95
item.guid: Noodles and Company-Delicious Duo: Entree and Side from $9.9-2026-08-21
item.description: Order any entree paired with a side dish starting at $9.95 at Noodles and Company; no promo code needed, available online and in-store at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: 6-Inch Sub of the Day Combo for $6.99
item.guid: Subway-6-Inch Sub of the Day Combo for $6.99-2026-08-21
item.description: Get the featured 6-inch sub of the day plus chips and a drink for $6.99 every day at participating Subway locations; no app required. (Ongoing)

item.title: Shake Shack: App Pricing: $2 Sodas and $4 Fries
item.guid: Shake Shack-App Pricing: $2 Sodas and $4 Fries-2026-08-21
item.description: Order through the Shake Shack app or website at participating locations and pay just $2 for fountain sodas and $4 for crinkle-cut fries, saving versus in-store prices. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chilis: 3 For Me Value Menu from $10.99
item.guid: Chilis-3 For Me Value Menu from $10.99-2026-08-21
item.description: Dine in at Chilis and choose an appetizer or non-alcoholic drink, an entree, and a non-alcoholic beverage from the 3 For Me menu starting at $10.99 per person. (Ongoing)
